scope: Closed-beta hosted shared-link recipient clickthrough and open tracking proof

codeFix.problemObserved: The earlier invite email CTA used a relative share href. Gmail rewrote it through a Google redirect notice as an invalid http:///share URL.
codeFix.fixSummary: Recipient email CTA and unsubscribe links now build absolute HTTP(S) URLs from existing app-origin env when the app supplies a relative /share path.

browserProof.tool: Computer Use against the existing Google Chrome profile
browserProof.ownerSession: Production Tropical House workspace loaded with the existing owner session.
browserProof.sharedLinkModal: The hosted shared-link modal showed an absolute https://www.archestimator.com/share/[redacted] base link.
browserProof.resendAction: The Recipients tab resent only the user-provided alternate recipient address.
browserProof.recipientInbox: A recent Gmail search in lewisphilipjonechavez@gmail.com found the new Archestimator invite at about 1:28 AM local time.
browserProof.freshEmailLinkDisplay: The fresh email body displayed archestimator.com/share/[redacted] for the CTA and archestimator.com/api/share/[redacted]/unsubscribe for unsubscribe.
browserProof.clickthroughResult: Clicking the fresh View Project Estimate CTA opened the hosted proposal review page instead of the old Google invalid-redirect notice.

closedByThisArtifact: Hosted shared-link recipient open tracking proof
stillOpen: Any broader automatic email lifecycle claim that requires provider event proof
